spans.s: Traibali, a muni. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 108 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).
Traiśīrsha, adj. (“relating to Triśiras [i.e. Viśvarūpa]”). § 555 (Indravijaya): V, 10, 335 (ºayā…brahmahatyayā).

Traigarta^1 (“king of the Trigartas”) = Suśarman: IV, 1070 (Sº), 1109; VI, 3856 (Prasthalādhipaḥ, C. has by error Taiº, B. Triº), 3857 (so B., C. Triº), 4736 (Sº), 5289 (Prasthalādhipaḥ); IX, 93 (narādhipaḥ, had been slain).
Traigarta^2, adj. (“belonging to the Trigartas”).--§ 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 33, 1117 (balaṃ).

Traigarta, pl. (ºāḥ), a people = Trigarta, pl. § 576 (Bhaga vadgītāp.): VI, 18, 688 (protected Bhīshma).--§ 582 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 71, 3132 (supported Śakuni).-§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 18, 727, 746 (fought with Arjuna).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 107, 4030 (ºānāṃ mahārathe, i.e. Vīradhanvan).
Traigartaka, adj. (“belonging to the Trigartas”). § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 18, 726 (bhrātṝn).--§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 74, 2167 (ºyodhāḥ), 2171 (ºmahārathāḥ. vanquished by Arjuna).
Traigartī (“daughter of the Trigarta king”) = Yaśodharā: I, 3788 (Yº).
Traipura (“the king of Tripurā”, BR.). § 284 (Sahadeva): II, 31, 1164 (in the south, vanquished by Sahadeva).
Traipura, pl. (ºāḥ), a people (“the inhabitants of Tripurā”). § 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 87, 3855 (followed Bṛhadbala).

*traividya (“the three vedas”): III, 13779 (ºvṛddhāḥ); XII, 545 (ºvṛddhānāṃ), 8201 (ºvṛddhān), 9721 (ºvṛddhāḥ); XIII, 5109 (ºvṛddhebhyaḥ); cf. trayī.--Do.^2, adj. (“familiar with the three vedas”); VI, 1190; XII, 2424 (brāhmaṇānāṃ). 2469 (vipreshu), 5972; XIII, 6455 (brāhmaṇaḥ).
Traiyambaka, adj. (“belonging to Tryambaka” [i.e. Śiva]). § 589 (Droṇābhishekap.): VII, 7, 169 (ishvastraṃ, known by Droṇa).--§ 596 (Pratijñāp.): VII, 79, 2778 (baliṃ).
